Author: Lucas
Name: DLSS Fix
Punchline: DLSS at a fixed internal resolution, no dynamic resolution.
Description: Locks FFXIV's DLSS to a fixed internal resolution (DLAA / Quality / Balanced / Performance / Ultra Performance / Custom) instead of the game's dynamic resolution. Also picks the DLSS model preset, updates nvngx_dlss.dll from NVIDIA's official DLSS SDK, adds CAS sharpening and NVIDIA Reflex (low latency + precise frame cap), fixes the refresh rate the game reads on multi-monitor setups, checks that the game's graphics options are set right, and reads the live G-Sync state and the game's G-Sync driver profile settings.
